sources.title: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
sources.text: MCP is an open standard for connecting data sources and AI-powered tools. Developers can expose data through MCP servers or build MCP clients that connect to these servers.
quotes: The Model Context Protocol is an open standard that enables developers to build secure, two-way connections between their data sources and AI-powered tools. The architecture is straightforward: developers can either expose their data through MCP servers or build AI applications (MCP clients) that connect to these servers.

sources.title: Agent2Agent (A2A)
sources.text: A2A enables agents from different frameworks and companies to communicate and collaborate. Agents can discover capabilities, negotiate interaction modalities and collaborate on long-running tasks without exposing internal state, memory or tools.
quotes:
With A2A, agents can:

- Discover each other's capabilities.
- Negotiate interaction modalities (text, forms, media).
- Securely collaborate on long-running tasks.
- Operate without exposing their internal state, memory, or tools.

The Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol addresses a critical challenge in the AI landscape: enabling gen AI agents, built on diverse frameworks by different companies running on separate servers, to communicate and collaborate effectively - as agents, not just as tools.

sources.title: Gemini CLI 终端助手
sources.text: Gemini CLI 是把 Gemini 接入终端的开源 AI agent。可通过 npx 直接运行、npm 全局安装，或用 Homebrew 安装；支持 MCP 扩展。
quotes:
Gemini CLI is an open-source AI agent that brings the power of Gemini directly
into your terminal.

- **🔌 Extensible**: MCP (Model Context Protocol) support for custom
 integrations.

sources.title: FlashMLA 注意力算子
sources.text: FlashMLA provides optimized attention kernels for DeepSeek-V4.1 inference on NVIDIA GPUs and Huawei Ascend NPUs. The 2026.09.30 release removed Hopper and earlier-model support and changed the FP8 / FP4 KV cache format; previous models and formats require an earlier commit.
quotes: FlashMLA is DeepSeek's library of optimized attention kernels, powering inference of the [DeepSeek-V4.1](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash) model on NVIDIA GPUs and Huawei Ascend NPUs.

In the 2026.09.30 release, we removed support for the Hopper architecture and for earlier models (including DeepSeek V3 / V3.2 / V4.0), and we changed the FP8 / FP4 KV cache format. This version is therefore not compatible with previous ones.

sources.title: udocker 用户空间容器
sources.text: udocker runs simple Docker containers in user space without root privileges. It supports Linux systems where Docker is unavailable, requires no administrator-deployed service, and implements a subset of Docker capabilities.
quotes: udocker is a basic user tool to execute simple docker containers in user space without requiring root privileges. Enables download and execution of docker containers by non-privileged users in Linux systems where docker is not available.
udocker does not require any type of privileges nor the deployment of services by system administrators.
udocker is a wrapper around several tools and libraries to mimic a subset of the docker capabilities including pulling images and running containers with minimal functionality.

sources.title: Z.AI Pricing 定价
sources.text: Z.AI prices are in USD. Text-model prices are per 1M tokens, with separate input, cached input and output charges. In the saved capture, GLM-4.7 lists $0.6 input, $0.11 cached input and $2.2 output; Web Search costs $0.01 per use. These are captured prices, not a promise of current origin pricing.
quotes: This page provides pricing information for Z.AI’s models and tools. All prices are in USD.
